label: Every finite interval sequence has cumulative output bounded by stock and input, by ledger arithm…
description: For real sequences stock,input,output, nonnegative stock and stock(t+1)+output(t)=stock(t)+input(t) imply every finite output sum is at most stock(0) plus the corresponding input sum. This arithmetic theorem needs no positivity assumption on input or output. Analyst conditional model only; no universal causal or existential bridge.
